ALGER, 18/07/2026 (Algeria Tech) — Le mi: ALGIERS, 07/18/2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Ministry of Post and Telecommunications announces measures to generalize the use of the IPv6 protocol in Algeria. An explanatory video is published on YouTube.
Généralisation du protocole IPv6 en Algé: Generalization of the IPv6 protocol in Algeria
Le ministère de la Poste et des Télécomm: The Ministry of Post and Telecommunications announced a series of measures aimed at generalizing the use of the IPv6 protocol in the country's wilayas. An explanatory video, broadcast on the official YouTube channel, details the advantages of this technology and the stages of its implementation. The IPv6 protocol, successor to IPv4, makes it possible to significantly increase the number of available IP addresses, a crucial issue for the development of national digital infrastructures.
L'initiative s'inscrit dans le cadre des: The initiative is part of Algeria's efforts to modernize its telecommunications network and strengthen its digital sovereignty. The services concerned include national operators and public and private players in the ICT sector.
